explanation: N998+ is an accumulated domain detector for physical technology: it is active while the preceding few dozen tokens are dense in industrial/electrical vocabulary - electrical and electronic components (resistor, capacitor, transistor, chip), machine parts (gearbox, piston, bearing, turbine, pump, valve), metals and engineering materials (steel, aluminium, alloy, chromium, polymer, ceramic), chemical elements and compounds (ammonia, ethanol, carbon) and generic device words (device, component, assembly) - and its strength rises monotonically with how many such terms have been read (peak ~1.0 for one term, ~1.7 for two, ~2.4 for eight). Text about food, people, politics, medicine, geology, civil structures, brands or abstract argument leaves it at its floor, and it decays to zero within ~30-50 tokens of a switch away from technology, so its highest tokens inside a technical passage are common ones (a comma, 'the', 'a') rather than a particular trigger word (the two Dutch retail/hotel snippets in the top 20 are the leftovers this leaves).
